summary: Phase 149O.20L.7J -- DeploymentBinding Producer Implementation Independent Verification. Verification-only -- no producer implementation modified, no HBDC-001 text amended, no real DeploymentBinding created, no Dell mutation. Independently reconstructed and adversarially verified 149O.20L.7I's implementation of HBDC-REQ-056..070 against primary source (contract text, production source, git history, live adversarial execution), never using 7I's own report or test module as an oracle. Byte-hash proof (git hash-object, not diff inference) that hatp_bootstrap.py and repository_identity.py are unchanged since 7H, and that HBDC-001's text is unchanged since 7H. Independently confirmed the exact two-file production diff scope (scripts/hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py, src/pcae/core/hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py, both new, zero modifications elsewhere). Built a full requirement-to-code traceability matrix for HBDC-REQ-056..070 from primary contract text. Whole-src/pcae-tree agent-reachability grep (stronger than 7I's own 3-file check) confirms zero importers besides the module itself; pyproject.toml confirms the only console-script entry point is pcae.cli:main. Ran 44 independent live adversarial checks against disposable trust stores/repositories (not reusing 7I's fixtures or oracle): a temporal idempotency attack on the valid_from-exclusion in create_deployment_binding's idempotency comparison, independently classified CORRECT CONSERVATIVE IMPLEMENTATION (not merely accepted from 7I's own rationale); a RepositoryIdentity-spoofing attack (copying a repository's .pcae/ tree into a second path) -- deterministically fails closed as DuplicateConflictingBindingError because canonical_deployment_root differs, reproduced twice; canonical-root relative-path and symlink-convergence attacks; an instrumented-spy proof of zero ensure_repository_identity() calls during create/rotate/revoke; F4 lost-history reconstruction via the provenance log, confirming an explicit previous-principal-to-new-principal linkage in the rotate audit summary, exceeding 7H's own named minimum expectation; a live audit-failure-after-durable-mutation fault injection, confirming the mutation stays durable and the exception propagates uncaught with no audit record written -- named as a real, non-blocking exception-type gap (no purpose-built exception subtype distinguishes this specific case); a symlink-swap race against the registry path mid-lifecycle, failing closed; real multi-process (not thread) concurrency -- six separate OS processes issuing identical creates converged on exactly one registry entry; a crash-with-held-lock test (SIGKILL of a lock-holding child process) confirming the OS releases flock state automatically and the next writer proceeds within milliseconds; fsync-failure and rename-failure fault injection, confirming no partial registry.json and no leaked temp file in either case; a hand-placed noncanonical timestamp artifact confirming the existing consumer's read-path parser remains permissive (unchanged, correctly not repaired this phase) while the producer's own strict grammar independently rejects the same string; a disposable HBDC-REQ-042 round trip (producer create -> HATPTrustStore load -> deployment_binding_matches) confirming both theft-defense directions (wrong root, wrong repository_id) correctly fail to match, and a post-revoke binding correctly no longer matches; multi-repository isolation and same-repository-identity-at-a-second-root semantics (operationally confirms 7H's own named 'no host identity in schema' finding is the contract's own chosen design, not a new defect); and a live empirical check that the real admin CLI's production path (no --protected-root override reachable, confirmed both via --help and live invocation) correctly resolves the real, absent production Protected Root and fails closed, writing nothing. New named finding this phase: src/pcae/core/hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py and scripts/hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py are absent from HMIC-001's 28-entry _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES set (independently read from hatp_mandatory_certification.py), unlike the directly analogous, already-frozen precedent scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py -- classified as an HMIC source-scope gap (not intentional, not irrelevant), non-blocking to HBDC-REQ-056..070 compliance specifically but recommended to close via a dedicated future phase before any real HMIC certification is relied upon to cover this producer. Independently reconstructed the regression baseline via an immutable git worktree at the true pre-7I commit (e9cad634), not 7I's self-reported counts: 208 failed/7457 passed/5 skipped/10 errors pre-7I vs. 216 failed/7545 passed/5 skipped/10 errors at HEAD. Diffed the full sorted FAILED/ERROR node-ID sets (comm -23/-13), not just the aggregate counts: exactly 8 net-new failures, 0 resolved. Individually inspected every one of the 8: all are historical, self-referential 'as of phase X, this thing does not exist yet' pin assertions spanning 7 distinct earlier phases (149O.19.5E.3, 19.5F, 19.5G, 20F, 20K.2, 20L.7G, 20L.7H) -- one (19.5G's writer-primitive reachability scan) is a lexical false positive tripped by this module's own docstring prose mentioning an HMIC writer-primitive's name descriptively, independently confirmed non-blocking by reading the actual code (no such call exists). Zero real authority/security regressions found. Verdict: REGRESSION CLEAN WITH EXPECTED HISTORICAL PIN MIGRATION. Every one of 7H's own carried findings individually re-adjudicated at the implementation layer this phase (not accepted as closed merely because the implementation chose one interpretation) -- see report section 37. Final verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- READY FOR FIRST-USE PREPARATION. Companion independent-oracle test module written: 20 tests, all passing standalone, encoding this phase's own findings (byte-hash immutability proofs, agent-unreachability, idempotency valid_from-exclusion, F4 audit linkage content, audit-failure-after-mutation durability, multi-process concurrency convergence, canonical-root symlink convergence, RepositoryIdentity-spoofing determinism, REQ-042 round trip, HMIC frozen-set non-membership as a permanent regression guard). Existing suites independently re-run and green: tests/test_hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py (55 passed), tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7i_deploymentbinding_producer_implementation.py (41 passed), tests/test_hatp_bootstrap_foundation.py (26 passed).
